issues.description: The problem UML and description indicate that Animal.messageOnFeed() is an abstract (and by UML visibility a public) method that subclasses should implement and that other classes (e.g., Farm) will call. In the solution, messageOnFeed() is declared protected abstract in Animal, which conflicts with the UML/public expectation. This visibility mismatch can confuse students about the intended visibility of the abstract method and the required signature they should implement.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the abstract method's visibility consistent with the UML/specification by declaring it public in the Animal class (public abstract String messageOnFeed()). Update the Animal class in the solution (and template guidance if present) so the method is public, and ensure subclasses implement a matching public method signature.
